question: Ascent, 5v5 full-buy execute on A Site, 65s. You are Jett entry at A Main (2 smokes, dash). One DEF spotted on A Site. How do you take the entry?

options.label: Smoke one angle (e.g. Heaven/CT), swing the other with dash after a teammate flash
options.explication_courte: Smoking the un-challenged angle cuts sightlines; entering after a team flash and clearing the remaining angle with Jett dash is the Radiant entry sequence.

options.label: Dash directly onto site without smoke or flash to surprise the DEF with raw speed, let teammates trade
options.explication_courte: A surprise dash can work if teammates immediately trade, but entering without util exposes Jett to multiple uncleared angles; viable but riskier.

sources_option.citation: Flash before you swing or smoke the angle you aren't challenging; entering dry exposes you to multiple sightlines at once versus one cleared angle at a time.

options.label: Wide-swing the A Main choke in spray-transfer to cover both site angles simultaneously
options.explication_courte: Wide-swinging into two sightlines splits your focus and hands a pre-aimed DEF a free shot; you cannot win both duels at once.

sources_option.citation: Clear one angle at a time, do not wide swing into three sightlines simultaneously; wide swinging into pre-aimed defenders hands them the duel.

options.label: Let a teammate push in first and hang back to preserve Jett for a potential clutch later
options.explication_courte: Jett is the entry fragger: her kit exists to create space first. Hanging back wastes her kit and leaves the push a body short.

sources_option.citation: If you're alive at the end of every round but not getting kills as a duelist, you're not playing the role; your job is to take space first and win the opening duel.

explication_longue:
Situation: execute A Site Ascent in 5v5 full-buy, 65 seconds, team stacked at A Main. You are Jett with 2 Cloudbursts and a dash. One DEF spotted on A Site, 4 positions unknown.

Entry fraggers create space by cutting sightlines then entering after util. The Radiant Jett entry sequence on A Ascent: (1) smoke one angle to cut the crossfire, (2) wait for a teammate flash to blind remaining defenders, (3) dash onto site and clear the unsmoked angle while the flash is active. This reduces a multi-angle problem to a single duel.

Dashing in blind without util (acceptable) can catch defenders off-guard but exposes you to multiple uncleared angles. Wide-swinging the main choke (costly) splits your attention between two sightlines - a pre-aimed DEF punishes the exposure. Hanging back (mistake) wastes the entire Jett kit and your role.

Estimated elite distribution: ~55% smoke+flash+dash entry, ~22% dash surprise, ~16% wide-swing (costly), ~5% hang back (mistake).

sources.citation: Flash before you swing, smoke off the angle you are not challenging, and clear one angle at a time; do not wide swing into multiple sightlines at once.
An entry visualizes how the defense sets up to prioritize which angles to clear, with good crosshair placement to flick between potential positions.
Jett is a top entry agent because her dash and smokes create space; take first contact, your kit is built to survive or win the opening duel.

_gaps.incertitude: Un seul DEF est confirme sur A Site ; la ligne optimale (quel angle fumer) depend du setup defensif exact (Heaven vs Tree vs Generator) non specifie. Un juge Immortal+ trancherait selon la comp adverse.
Le dash dry est classe 'acceptable' mais en contexte fast-execute coordonne certains le jugeraient optimal ; la frontiere depend du tempo d'equipe (info non encodee).
Estimations depuis guides entry/duelist (dotesports, mobalytics, oneesports) ; les vraies frequences varient selon le meta duelist et la map.
